_doc: The money rules, shared by the server (internal/game/economy.go, which owns every dollar) and the client (buy menu, HUD). CS2 competitive values. killReward is by weapon class (weapons.json 'class').

gpudrop._doc: GPU Drop (docs/gpu-drop.md): grab, secure (the carrier; secureTeam: every other Vibe Coder) and restock rewards; carrySpeed scales the carrier's move speed

race._doc: Race mode (docs/racing.md, internal/game race.go): a kill with a car item or a ram, a lap finished in the lead, a Bonus Approved pickup, the finish by place (then finish for the rest)

gear.name: Hoodie + Noise-cancelling Headphones
gear.desc: 100 armor + helmet (350 if you have the hoodie)

gear.name: Rollback Kit
gear.desc: git revert in half the time

gear.name: Senior-dev Sunglasses
gear.desc: a Stack Trace blinds you 60% shorter; seen it all before

gear.name: 10x Energy Drink
gear.desc: +10% move speed for 10 s; you are now a 10x engineer (briefly)

gear.name: Gravity Override
gear.desc: boots + a grappling hook (F): hook a wall, touch it, now it is the floor. Down is a social construct

tickets._doc: Tickets mode (docs/starslop.md): the loadouts a player picks on the spawn screen (no buying). 'rifle' is the team's rifle (the Prompt for Earth, the Linter for the Moon).

kits.name: Intern Rifleman
kits.desc: The team rifle and a smoke. Does whatever the ticket says.

kits.name: Senior Sniper
kits.desc: Code Review and a Hotfix. One review every 1.5 s: never wrong, rarely fast.

kits.name: Staff Engineer
kits.desc: The Token Burner and grenades. Rockets once the RFC is approved.

kits.name: Product Manager
kits.desc: Autocomplete, a Rubber Duck and a smoke to hide the roadmap.
